detail.longDescription: Have you ever signed up for an organization's newsletter and immediately felt out of the loop—like you missed a hundred emails leading up to the most recent one? That's because new newsletter subscribers only see the emails that come after they've signed up. Everything before that is lost to the void. Drip marketing is the solution.
